paper.title: MASS-HBM: A Multiphysics Atom-to-System Simulation Tool for Thermal-Reliability-Aware System-Technology Co-Optimization of HBM

mesh.representation: structured Cartesian fields; uniform x/y and nonuniform z
mesh.connectivity_adapter: derive 6-neighbor Cartesian adjacency from shape and spacing

paper_derived_facts: The solver uses a self-consistent electrothermal loop that updates temperature-dependent conductivity, interface resistance, and leakage/refresh power until temperature and power converge.
Thermal conductivity is described as k(T,sigma), and interface resistance as temperature/stress dependent.
Adaptive meshing starts from structure/interface information and subsequently follows the evolving temperature field, retaining refinement near hotspots.
The architecture space includes 2.5D, 3D-P, 3D-V and liquid-cooled variants; liquid channels can be inserted between groups.
The paper uses 75 degC warning and 100 degC critical temperature thresholds.
The paper presents stress/strain and reliability outputs, but that does not establish that stress/strain fields are present in this handoff dataset.

nominal_k.meaning: reference/baseline material conductivity before temperature feedback

final_q.meaning: converged volumetric heat generation including electrothermal feedback

quantitative_ranges.interpretation: Some k, q, thickness and point-count ranges overlap, but geometry, state dependence, interface resistance and internal-cooling semantics do not; numerical overlap is not physics compatibility.

efficiency_benchmark.cache_policy: report uncached geometry and cached-identical-geometry separately; never hide preprocessing or query construction
efficiency_benchmark.break_even_formula: N_break_even = training_compute_cost / (MASS_HBM_warm_case_cost - Heat3D_warm_case_cost); also report cold and engineering-inclusive variants

metric_contract.rmse_K: volume-weighted per-sample RMSE in kelvin; report sample distribution and aggregate explicitly
metric_contract.peak_temperature_error: signed and absolute error of sample maximum in kelvin
metric_contract.hotspot_top1pct_rmse: RMSE K on truth-defined hottest 1% by physical volume
metric_contract.hotspot_location_error: Euclidean distance in mm between truth/predicted maxima plus optional top-1% centroid distance
metric_contract.threshold_75C: pointwise and case-level confusion, precision, recall, F1 and temperature-margin error
metric_contract.threshold_100C: pointwise and case-level confusion, precision, recall, F1 and temperature-margin error
metric_contract.efficiency: cold/warm latency, throughput and peak host/accelerator memory

unknowns_for_authors: Provide stress/strain field files, units, discretization location and whether they are initial or converged; none are in the handoff manifest.
Specify the exact functional forms and parameters for k(T,sigma), Rint(T,sigma), leakage P(T) and refresh feedback needed to reconstruct deployable pre-solve inputs.
Confirm whether every packaged power_density_map.npy is iteration-final and identify a canonical iteration-0 volumetric map for every case.
Confirm whether packaged solver geometry is pre-solve or the result of temperature-guided adaptation/local refinement, and provide a target-independent base mesh if different.
Define the face indexing/orientation of final_interface_tbr_map.npz for all architectures, especially rotated_homogenized_tensor cases.
Clarify whether LC-V sink audit fields are design inputs or include converged-temperature controller updates, and provide the pre-solve sink field contract.
Explain the one case with interface_review_status=REVIEW_REQUIRED before it enters any split.
Provide comparable per-phase timing instrumentation and hardware details for mesh, coupled update and thermal solve.
